about: General (standard/largest-employer) minimum wage changes, 2000-01-01 through 2026-01-01, federal and 56 places. rateMinor is cents. DOL history table is Jan 1 year-values, so rows with a year-only date carry `estimated`. Rows with sourceId RECALL were not fetched and need verification. Where a state's rate is below federal, the state's own rate is recorded and the federal floor governs. Tiered states: upper/largest-employer tier recorded; see notes.

sources.title: DOL WHD, Changes in Basic Minimum Wages in Non-Farm Employment Under State Law: Selected Years 1968 to 2024 (values as of Jan 1 of each year; fetched through a page summarizer, upper tier used where ranges are shown)
DOL WHD, State Minimum Wage Laws (current rates; page dated July 2026)
Fair Labor Standards Amendments of 1996 (Small Business Job Protection Act, P.L. 104-188) and Fair Minimum Wage Act of 2007 (P.L. 110-28)
HR Morning / Inova Payroll lists of January 1, 2026 and 2026 mid-year state minimum wage changes
CRS RL30235, Minimum Wage in the Territories and Possessions of the United States (2007 law raising American Samoa and CNMI by $0.50 steps)
Value recalled from state announcements, not fetched this session; verify against the state labor department
